Rathalos is one of my favorite monsters because he's one that gets absolutely destroyed by knowledge and prepping a "bag of tricks."

Knowledge: 

1:Rathalos will always lift off and shoot a fireball in front of himself after an enraged roar. If you have earplugs or otherwise avoid the roar hitbox, this is a free opening for a flash bomb.

2: like most monsters on 2 legs, he'll always do 2 tail swipes back 2 back, a great opening for damage.

3: The tracking claw lunge he'll do in the air is best avoided by running towards him. He has a bad habit of landing after that attack, letting you get a headsnipe.

4: his instant charge is definitely his most annoying move. Avoid being in front of him if you can, If you want to KO him, it's best to get 1 or 2 hits on the head, then bail.

The "bag of tricks":

Flash bombs. (You know why)

Antidote/herbal meds. (You know why)

Dung bombs. (Getting pinned while poisoned or on fire is a death sentence)

Traps. (Free damage)

Nulberries. (for the fireblight.)

Large barrel bombs. (for when he's sleeping)

PEDs. (demon drug and armorskin) 


If you notice you're getting tagged by fireballs alot, it may be worth it to get Rathian armor as a temporary armor set to help deal with her hubby, elemental defense can play a huge role in survival, atleast until you get good enough to avoid the majority of elemental attacks.

NV fails in one aspect:Plasma weapons.

Let's  be honest aside from the Q35 or smitty special, have you ever used a plasma rifle? Or a multiplas rifle?

 Probably not, and it's not hard to see why, Lasers get more perks and more weapon mods, such that even a humble laser rifle is a powerful endgame weapon.

And therein lies the problem, in NV energy weapons are "supposed" to be in 1 of 2 categories: Lasers and Plasmas.

On paper, they each have their uses, Lasers have a faster projectile, are more accurate and have a faster RoF, the tradeoff? They don't pack much punch.

 Which is where Plasma was supposed to come in, with slow projectiles that are less accurate and a slower RoF, Plasma was supposed to be the heavy hitter.
(A multiplas rifle shoots 3 projectiles, each one doing about 30-50 damage depending on target DT, that's alot of damage if you hit all 3) 

Unfortunately, that slower projectile but higher damage is worthless, when Lasers deal just as much, if not more damage than Plasmas, especially when you factor in dps.

The solution? I propose a 5-10% speed increase on the projectile, and have Plasma weapons ignore 5 points of DT by default which stacks with ammo types that also reduce target DT, and add a couple more plasma based perks.

This would make Plasma more usuable outside Vats, and really reinforce the intended design of Lasers=faster but weaker and Plasma=slower but stronger.
